name: Compliance Theater 2000
description: Rich education compliance analysis support for Codex, including authenticated MCP access to policy, evidence, and compliance workflows.

settings.name: targetServerUrl
settings.label: Target server URL
settings.description: Base URL for the upstream service or remote MCP endpoint.

settings.name: authorizationIssuer
settings.label: Authorization issuer
settings.description: OAuth issuer used to discover /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server metadata.

settings.name: clientId
settings.label: OAuth client ID
settings.description: OAuth public client identifier used for interactive login.

settings.name: clientSecret
settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.description: Optional OAuth client secret for confidential clients.

settings.name: oauthScope
settings.label: OAuth scope
settings.description: Space-delimited scopes requested for resource and tool access.

settings.name: mcpCommand
settings.label: MCP command
settings.description: Command that starts the real MCP server.

settings.name: mcpArgs
settings.label: MCP args
settings.description: JSON array of arguments for the real MCP server command.
